summary: Complete independent Chinese source-date audit of all 250 units, 85 temporal or active-hint items, and 37 people. Direct Qing regnal-year conversions and named event ownership are generally supported. One corrupt or unverified era reading and several early-, mid-, or reign-reference phrases have nevertheless been inflated into point dates or whole-reign personal activity ranges. No source or extraction data was changed.
